title: SCAD-Brain: a public database of single cell RNA-seq data in human and mouse brains with Alzheimer's disease
tissue: multiple brain regions (pooled cortices, hippocampus, prefrontal cortex, caudal entorhinal cortex, superior frontal gyrus, superior frontal cortex, superior parietal lobe, white matter, gray matter, dorsolateral prefrontal cortex)
reason: This paper describes a comprehensive collection of 21 AD scRNA-seq datasets (359 samples, 1.56M cells) from human and mouse brains across 10 regions, providing processed data and analysis results. The multi-sample, multi-batch, cross-dataset nature makes it highly suitable for benchmarking data integration and harmonization methods.
methods_summary: Raw scRNA-seq data from GEO and Synapse were processed with CellRanger (10x) or Trimmomatic/Hisat2/Samtools (Smart-seq2). Seurat was used for normalization, HVG selection, PCA, UMAP, clustering, and cell type annotation. Differential expression, pathway enrichment (KEGG/GO), cell communication (CellChat), and trajectory analysis (Monocle) were performed. Results are accessible via the SCAD-Brain web interface.
